newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler denies talks on BMW unit.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler denies talks on BMW unit.

text.p: Chrysler Corp on Tuesday denied a published report that it is in talks to buy the Rover small car unit of Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW).
"There is no truth to that," said Chrysler spokesman Mike Aberlich.
BMW also denied the report, which appeared in the Tuesday edition of The Times newspaper.
Aberlich said rumors about Chrysler buying parts of British automaker Rover have surfaced numerous times in the past.
He said Chrysler officials have been visiting Rover facilities in Britain but the visits are connected to a small-car engine plant that BMW and Chrysler are building in Brazil.
"Our people have been in England to look at the Rover facility. Why? Because we're going to build an engine plant," the spokesman said.
Chrysler and BMW announced last September a joint venture to build a $500 million facility that will produce an estimated 400,000 1.4-liter and 1.6-liter four-cylinder engines annually.
